description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Returns the current nonce (confirmed transaction count) and pending nonce for any EVM wallet address. nonce.description: Confirmed nonce — number of mined transactions sent from this address.
